phases.message: These are my walk recordings of the kitchen. Read what the camera counted each week, what was promised out loud and by whom, and which of Halcrest's change orders can even be signed.

Now Halcrest's portal. Read the terms, the quote, the change orders, invoice INV-1043 and its images. Sign only a change that is priced, dated and what Marco actually said; approve what the walks saw installed; hold and ask about the rest. Then tell me what you held and why.

terms.text: Today is Monday 26 October 2026. Halcrest Remodeling client portal, contract HR-2609 with Elena Brandt for the kitchen at 41 Orchard Lane. Topics: contract, changes, payments, walks. Sign a change, approve an invoice line or send Halcrest a question from this portal.

- Contract HR-2609, signed 2026-09-18: the kitchen remodel at the quote's 14 lines, $41,180.00 in all.
- Halcrest's project lead is Marco Ruiz.
- A 10% deposit was paid on signing and is credited on the final invoice.
- The quote is the scope; anything else is a change.

- Section 6: no change is binding until the homeowner signs a written change order in this portal.
- A change order states its price in dollars, the days it adds to the schedule, and the quote line it amends.
- A change agreed out loud is not signed until it is written that way.
- Halcrest bills a change only after it is signed.

- Section 7: progress invoices bill work installed, line by line, at the quote's unit prices or a signed change's price.
- The homeowner may approve a line in part and hold the rest, for work not installed or a price not agreed, by telling Halcrest why in writing (a question from this portal) within 5 days of the invoice.
- Held money is paid once the work is installed or the price is signed.
- A line paid on an earlier invoice is not billed again.

- Section 9: the homeowner records a walk of the room about once a week; Halcrest agreed in writing to be recorded on 2026-09-18, and each walk opens with a spoken consent notice.
- A walk whose notice was not recorded is kept for its pictures only; its audio is not used.
- Halcrest's design packet images are renderings, not photographs of the work.
